request.purpose: We want to reduce sick leave. We will use the results to decide whose fixed-term contracts we do not renew.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of adults per age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per age band: adults with a BMI and their mean BMI, one decimal.
